effective_base.fallback: OLS is a secondary diagnostic if LASSO is unsuccessful, not the primary estimator.

replication.plot: Individual paired repetitions and arithmetic means with pointwise percentile bootstrap 95% intervals.
replication.stop_rule: Run all 20 declared triplets, irrespective of observed monotonicity; record all failures.

effective_base.selection_rule: Minimum independent-validation weak residual MSE among converged candidates; never use the true kernel or test trajectories. Ties choose the larger alpha.

estimators.primary: validation-selected raw weak LASSO with the unchanged 60-penalty path
estimators.secondary: raw minimum-norm weak OLS from numpy.linalg.lstsq with rcond=None

requested_protocol.evaluation_policy: Reuse each repetition's frozen held-out trajectory and existing full-pair evaluation statistics across estimators. Matched full-pair LASSO and OLS records are read-only comparisons.
requested_protocol.failure_policy: Retain every failed job, unselected or nonconverged candidate, boundary selection, rank deficiency, divergent rollout, basis-domain excursion, and missing metric. Never average only successful repetitions when an all-run statistic is declared.
requested_protocol.manuscript_instruction: Do not modify current figures, manuscript files, or authoritative full-pair outputs in this stage.
requested_protocol.purpose: Production candidate for Generic 1D Figure 1 with sampled ordered pairs at P=50N.
requested_protocol.representative_policy: After completing all 100 repetitions, choose the dictionary size with the smallest sampled-pair LASSO mean held-out force error; display global repetition 0 at that size without selecting a seed. Mark this dictionary choice as post-hoc visualization only.
requested_protocol.selection_policy: For each repetition and dictionary size, independently sampled validation pairs at P=50N select the converged LASSO candidate with minimum validation weak-residual MSE. Truth and held-out tests are excluded from selection.
